title: Rubio's 2020 intelligence committee provision and Mick's tweet

tellings.quote: 20th, 2020. Uh this is when Rubio snuck a uh a provision into you know what I'm talking about, right? stuck a provision into uh Senate in um intelligence committee language

plain: In 2020, Senator Marco Rubio is said to have slipped a UFO provision into the wording of a Senate Intelligence Committee report, which would mean Congress was quietly pushing the intelligence agencies on UFOs. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff says on the show that this is "when Rubio snuck a provision into Senate intelligence committee language," and he raises it in an exchange with Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, linking it to a tweet of West's whose content the telling does not give.
